module_summary: Ethernet frame N-to-1 multiplexer: an arbiter grants one source per frame, a frame flag latches its header, and a grant-indexed mux feeds payload through a skid-buffered AXI-Stream output register.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Frame-in-progress state: set at header accept, cleared on last payload beat; gates new header capture.

anchors.name: grant
anchors.why: One-hot grant from arbiter selecting the source; masks requests and drives header ready.

anchors.name: grant_encoded
anchors.why: Encoded grant index selecting header fields and payload lanes from the chosen source.

anchors.name: grant_valid
anchors.why: Arbiter grant valid; gates frame start, source tready and internal payload valid.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Per-source header valid; forms arbiter request vector.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Per-source header ready, pulsed to granted source at frame start.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid, registered at frame start and held until ready.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready; clears header valid and permits next frame start.

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Output header fields (dest/src MAC, type) latched from the granted source.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Concatenated per-source payload data, muxed by grant_encoded.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-source payload valid; selected beat valid and frame end acknowledge.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready steered only to the granted source when output can accept.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload data from the registered output slice.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from output register.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream payload ready; decides output/temp register transfers.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating input acceptance into output skid buffer.

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer data register holding a beat when output stalls.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable copying internal payload into output registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Load enable capturing internal payload into temp skid registers.

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable moving temp skid contents to output registers.

anchors.name: acknowledge
anchors.why: Arbiter acknowledge on last payload beat of granted source, releasing grant.

groups.name: Source arbiter
groups.description: Arbiter instance granting one source per frame; request from header valid, ack on tlast.

groups.name: Frame and header control
groups.description: Frame flag accepts granted header, latches MACs/type and drives header handshakes.

groups.name: Payload mux
groups.description: Selects granted source payload lanes into internal stream signals.

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output register plus temp register implementing registered AXI-Stream skid buffer.
